shared_elements: schematic rendering of body and limbs
justification: Both are weathered stone carvings in shallow relief with schematic human forms and at least one prominent circular/disc motif (the chariot wheel in A, the round boss on the torso in B). But A is a horizontal narrative panel with a dense, overlapping action scene of figures, horses and animals reading left to right, while B is a free-standing, frontal, columnar figure whose sparse ornament is arranged vertically on a body — the format, orientation and compositional logic have almost nothing in common.
